body:
I can't reproduce this on 4.4.dev aa65940a8 (Linux X11 KDE, single window mode enabled in the Editor Settings):

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a75197da-13b0-4b3e-826f-8b1ea366ed8b

However, if you have single window mode disabled (the default), it will constantly flicker back and forth:

<details>
<summary>Epilepsy warning (flashing lights)</summary>

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4cc405d1-ef86-4699-8a73-5472fb37ead5
</details>

This is spammed to stderr while moving the cursor:

```
ERROR: Invalid image: null
   at: create_from_image (scene/resources/image_texture.cpp:76)
```

This issue didn't occur in 4.3 and is likely a regression from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/88950. cc @bruvzg
